service.description: Illustrative regional emergency connectivity service with ground-device access and drone backhaul/telemetry support.

claim_boundary_notes: All numeric service, operating and fleet thresholds in this fixture are synthetic, illustrative benchmark targets.
The service is regional connectivity and drone data relay, not aircraft-to-aircraft energy transfer.
The two candidate references denote architecture families; no Sceye or Zephyr performance is assigned to the synthetic Luminous candidate.
Platform endurance, station-keeping, coverage availability and fleet availability are separate metrics.
Energy export is disabled in this profile; any later export service must pass a separate surplus-only energy admission contract.

assumptions: This is a synthetic mission contract and not a prediction or operating plan for any geographic region.
The 30-day service horizon, 10,000 km2 target area, 20,000 devices, 100 Mbps aggregate throughput, availability and latency targets are illustrative values.
The scenario is designed to compare fixed-wing and buoyant HAPS platforms on the same delivered communications service, including fleet failure and handover.
No aircraft geometry, installed mass, solar array, battery pack, propulsion, station-keeping controller or measured wind profile is assigned.
No spectrum use, public-airspace operation, flight test or power beaming is authorized by this profile.
